text: Coffee with Omar this morning, first proper catch up in ages. He's got a second interview at the council on Thursday at 10am, panel of three, and he has to do a ten minute presentation on community engagement. He's nervous about that bit, says he goes blank when people stare. His wife Nora is due in March 2027, first one for them, and they've just started clearing out the box room. Remind me to text Omar good luck on Wednesday night.

Long catch up with Meera after book club. Her sister Divya had the baby on Sunday morning, a little girl, 7lb 2oz, no name announced yet. Labour was long and Divya's still exhausted, her husband's mum has moved in for a fortnight to help. Christening is pencilled in for 6 December 2026. Meera's going to be godmother and is already panicking about the speech, she hates public speaking. Also, Meera's got her own interview at Aviva on the 3rd at 2pm.
Kate's housewarming is Saturday 7 November 2026 from 7. New place is in Headingley, two bed, tiny garden. She said bring nothing but I'll take a bottle of red anyway. Fern and Leon are coming too.
Varun didn't get the Deloitte job. Gutted, he really thought the final round went well. He's applying for two more this week. Remind me to message him Friday to see how he's holding up.
Spoke to Adaeze on the phone. Baby shower's off, her mum isn't well enough to travel so they've called it off. Doing a small family lunch instead on the 14th at 1. She sounded tired.
Haruto's leaving do is Friday at 5:30 at the Crown. He starts at Sony in Basingstoke on 2 November 2026. Need to chip in for the card and gift, Anders is collecting.
Dinner at Simone and Paolo's last night. They're expecting again! Due June 2027. Their eldest starts nursery in January. Paolo's still at the bank but hates the commute.
Freya rang. Her interview at the hospital went really well, they're letting her know by Wednesday afternoon. Her dog Biscuit is having his teeth done on Monday too so she's all over the place.
Bumped into Mandla at the shop. His brother Thabo just moved back from Joburg and is job hunting, mostly logistics roles. Mandla asked if I knew anyone. I should ask Claire if her place is hiring.

Lin's 40th is a surprise party on 21 November 2026 at 8pm, at the Italian place on Grove Rd. Her husband is organising, he messaged everyone separately so Lin doesn't see a group chat. Guests need to be there by half 7. Simone and Paolo are coming, Jada too if she's up to it. Gift idea, Lin mentioned at work she wants a proper coffee grinder, the burr kind. Must order it this week so it arrives in time.
Grocery run tomorrow morning before 9. Also book the car in for its MOT, due end of November.
Dafydd and Ciara got the keys! Housewarming planned for early December, date tbc. Dafydd's mum is helping them paint this weekend. Ciara's started a new job at the uni, admin in the physics dept.

Chloe's struggling. Six applications, no callbacks, and her contract at the museum ends 31 December 2026. She's had a rough few months generally, her and her partner split in the summer and she's back at her dad's. She's thinking of retraining as a teacher, maybe primary. Remind me to send her that link about PGCE open evenings, the next one's Tuesday 10 November at 6pm.
Quick call with Giulia. Her niece's christening is on Sunday 15 November at 11am in Bologna, she's flying out Friday night. She's gluten free now btw, doctor's orders. Back on the Tuesday.

Sunil got the job!! Senior analyst at the NHS trust, starts 4 January 2027. Hadiza says he's been grinning for two days. They're having a few people round on Saturday to celebrate, I'm invited. Must get him a card.

Ana Wang's waters broke early this morning, three weeks early. Rosa just texted that mum and baby boy are both fine, born around 2pm. No name yet. Need to send flowers to Ana, maybe wait till they're home.
Rosa invited me to her 30th, dinner at Dishoom 13 March 2027 at 7:30. Booking for twelve. She's also doing a half marathon in April so no big night out after.

Elijah's got an interview at Google next Tuesday at 2. Fourth round, the system design one, and if it goes well there's a final chat with the hiring manager the week after. Says he isn't nervous but he definitely is, he kept changing the subject. His partner Aaliyah is cooking him a big dinner after whatever happens. Text him good luck Monday night, and call him Wednesday to find out how it went.
Jada had her 20 week scan yesterday, all fine. They're not finding out the gender. She's craving pickles constantly and can't stand the smell of coffee anymore. Due date is 9 February 2027.
Catalina Barros, new neighbour at number 12. Works nights as a nurse at St James's. Has a cat called Pepa. Invited me round for drinks some time next week.

Caught up with Anders after five a side. His wife Freya's pregnant, about 12 weeks, they're telling family at Christmas so keep it quiet. Morning sickness has been brutal for her. He's also interviewing for a team lead role internally on 3 November at 9am, up against two people from the Manchester office. Wants to quit if he doesn't get it, he's been passed over twice already. Their cat Miso knocked over the Christmas decorations box while I was there.
Meera's dinner party on Friday is cancelled, her kitchen ceiling has a leak. She's rescheduling for some time in January.
Remind me to ask Omar how the council interview went. It was Thursday.

Divya and her husband are christening the baby on 6 December at half 10, St Mary's. Reception after at the cricket club. Must RSVP by 20 November. Need to find a christening gift, Meera says a silver bracelet with her initials.
Varun again. Got a phone screen at Monzo tomorrow at 11 and a take home task for another place due Sunday night. He sounds better than last week. Ask him Friday how both went.
Fern said Leon's mum has been in hospital since the weekend, a fall. He's going down to Exeter tonight and will be back Thursday. Should check in with Leon.
Simone mentioned she's thinking about going back to work part time after the baby, maybe from September 2027. She used to do HR at Unilever. Wants something local.

Party at Kate's was great. Met her flatmate Giulia properly, she's an architect and into bouldering. Fern was there with her new boyfriend, didn't catch his name. Kate's planning a games night once a month.

Hadiza rang about Sunil's thing on Saturday. Starts at 7, bring a dish, I'm doing the jollof. Their daughter turns 5 the week after, on 31 October, party at soft play at 10am followed by cake back at theirs. She's mad about unicorns and anything glittery, Hadiza says please no more slime kits. Hadiza's own mum is visiting from Kano for a month from the 25th, first time she'll see the house.
Uncle Paolo's 70th dinner, Saturday 28 November 2026 at 6pm, the Royal Hotel. Mum wants us there by half 5. He's into fishing and old westerns. I'm sorting the cake with Rosa.
Note to self: update CV this weekend, apply for the Leeds role before the 30th at 5pm. Ask Thabo if he'd be a referee.

Claire's had her baby! a girl, born Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 4:12am. C-section, she's sore but okay. Her partner Dafydd is on paternity leave for two weeks. Want to drop round a lasagne next week, text first.
Omar's council interview: he got it! Starts 1 December. Nora's thrilled, it means he'll be home earlier once the baby comes. Must send congrats.
Freya didn't get the hospital job, they went with an internal candidate. She's okay about it, said she'd half expected it. Biscuit's teeth went fine though.

Elijah's housewarming has moved from the 31st to Sunday 8 November at 2pm, Eli says more of a lunch thing. Aaliyah's doing a barbecue if the weather holds. Should bring something veggie for Aaliyah's brother Sunil, he's veggie.
Book dentist. Pay council tax. Return the parcel before Friday 5pm.
Lin rang, she's been offered a role in Singapore starting March 2027. Huge decision, her husband would have to give up his job. She's going back and forth. Asked me not to mention it at the party.
Chatted with Nora at the antenatal class. She's 18 weeks, feeling sick most mornings still. Omar's been brilliant apparently. They've booked a babymoon in Lisbon for half term.
Leon's mum is home from hospital now, recovering slowly. He's taking her to physio Tuesday and Thursday mornings. Ask him at the weekend how she's getting on.

Ciara's 30th is next Saturday at 8, rooftop bar on Briggate. Dress code 70s, I need to find flares. Dafydd's trying to get her a surprise trip to Copenhagen for after, flying out Sunday 22 November and back the Wednesday. He wants people to chip in, around thirty quid each, and Ciara loves Danish design and anything by Arne Jacobsen. Her mum and her sister Rosa are flying over from Galway for the party. Transfer Dafydd the money by Friday.
Adaeze's family lunch went ahead on the 14th, mum managed to come in the end. The baby is due any day now, maybe even this weekend. Remind me to ring her on Monday.
Jada and her husband Leon are hosting a gender neutral baby shower, 23 January 2027 at 2pm. Anyone who wants can bring a book instead of a card. Giulia's helping with decorations.

Thabo's got an interview with DHL on Wednesday at 9:30am, warehouse ops manager. First interview in years and he's really anxious, hasn't slept properly since they called. Mandla wants me to do a mock interview with him tomorrow evening at 7, I've said yes. Thabo used to run a depot in Joburg for eight years so he knows his stuff, he just needs confidence. Don't forget to text Thabo good luck Tuesday night.
Anders didn't get the team lead role. He's handed in his notice, last day is 18 December. He's going freelance in the new year. Seems weirdly relieved.

Haruto's leaving drinks were fun. He's nervous about the move, renting a room in Basingstoke till he finds a flat. Kate cried a bit. Should send him a message his first week, see how Sony's treating him.
Mrs Popescu next door told me her granddaughter Ana was baptised on Sunday in the Orthodox church. Three hours long, apparently. She brought me some cozonac.
Divya's maternity leave ends in August 2027, she's not sure she's going back to the firm. The baby's sleeping better now. Meera thinks Divya should look into the job at her company.
Paolo's 70th was lovely. He cried at the slideshow. Rosa did a speech. Next family thing is cousin Chloe's engagement party, 16 January 2027 at 7pm, in Leeds.
Kate texted, her sister Jada went into labour early this morning. Kate's driving up tonight. Will check in tomorrow.
Varun Usman got an offer from Monzo! Junior data engineer, starts 11 January 2027. He's celebrating Saturday night at the pub, 8pm onwards. Bring Fern if she's free.
Simone and Paolo have invited us to their son's 3rd birthday, Sunday 1 November at 3pm. Theme is dinosaurs. He's obsessed with diggers too.

Spoke to Catalina. Her brother Paolo has a job interview in London on Monday at 4pm, and she's putting him up the night before. She's also on nights all next week, so drinks are pushed to the week after.
Mandla and his wife are pregnant, just told me at the barbecue. Baby due late May 2027. Their dog Rolo is going to be very confused. Mandla's taking paternity leave in June.
I'm hosting Christmas this year, 25 December. Need to order the turkey by 1 December and ask everyone about dietary stuff. Rosa's vegan now.
Elijah didn't get the Google job, they said he was a strong hire for a different team but nothing open. He's disappointed but taking a few weeks off. I should take him out for a pint next week.
Dafydd Moreau from work had a chat with me about his wife Hadiza's new business, she makes celebration cakes. Might be worth asking her for Paolo's next year.
Claire said the baby's christening is on Sunday 3 January 2027 at 11. She wants me to be godparent! Huge honour. Need to say yes properly and ask what's expected.
Freya's got another interview, this time at a private clinic, Monday the 9th at half 9. She's less nervous this time. Her partner Divya's taking her out for brunch after either way.
Sunil and Hadiza's do was brilliant. Sunil gave a little speech, their little one fell asleep under the table. Hadiza's thinking of going back to uni next September, nursing degree.

Nora and Omar's baby shower is 27 February 2027, 1pm, at Nora's parents' house in Harrogate. Gift hint from Nora: they still need a decent baby carrier, the Ergobaby one. Meera and Kate want to go halves with me. Omar's new job is going well so far, he's on a three month probation till March. Nora's finishing work on 5 February. Must sort the carrier money with Meera before the end of January.
